title: OPS-02 Final Independence, Clustering, and Multiplicity Audit

authoritative_terminology.mandate: C15 MUST NOT claim '212 independent physical samples'. The mandatory scientific phrasing is: '212 physical sample pairs derived from 64 independent parent/datatake acquisitions.'
authoritative_terminology.rationale: Slices extracted from the same parent acquisition share sensor calibration, sea state, and atmospheric conditions, causing along-track pseudo-replication if counted as independent.

along_track_clustering_verification.evaluation: All scenes sharing mission_data_take_id, platform, and orbit are collapsed into single parent clusters prior to partition assignment.
along_track_clustering_verification.constituent_scene_compression: 85 scenes collapsed into 64 clusters (21 along-track adjacent scenes unified with primary parent).
